newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai soybean futures close up on new buying.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai soybean futures close up on new buying.

text.p: Shanghai soybean futures ended mostly up on Friday, rising on a technical correction after falling for several days, traders said.
The key March 1997 contract ended unchanged at 3,122 yuan ($376) per tonne. It opened at 3,120 points and closed at the intraday high of 3,122 points.
May rose 11 to 3,050, and July 30 to 3,280. September closed unchanged at 3,337, November unchanged at 3,351.
Traders said many investors continued to offset long positions but new buyers entered the market.
"New buying offset selling pressure today and I think soybeans will continue to move at current levels in the next few days if no additional news affects the market," one trader said.
